description: Report a pull request's CI checks as counts per state plus the failing and pending checks. Defaults to the current branch's PR; passing checks are counted, not listed, unless all=true.

all.description: List passing and skipped checks too (default: only the rest)

cwd.description: Repository path (default: the server's working directory)

pr.description: PR number, URL or branch (default: the current branch's PR)

name: gh_pr_checks
title: PR checks
